title: Input/Output Token Breakdown
description: Surface input vs output token split per validation run. Depends on upstream agent-manager exposing the split in RunSummary (currently only combined tokens_used is exposed).

requirements.title: Consume input/output split + render
requirements.description: Once agent-manager's RunSummary exposes input_tokens + output_tokens, extend ValidationRecord schema, persist them on run capture, and render the split in CLI/UI alongside the combined total. Blocked on the upstream change.
